data.outcome_summary: TALIS Starting Strong 2024 is an OECD large-scale survey of early childhood education and care (ECEC) staff and setting leaders, using self-reported questionnaires about background, training, daily work, practices with children and families, and well-being/job satisfaction/career intentions. In Türkiye, the note reports indicator-style results for pre-primary settings (ISCED 02), including public and private kindergartens and practice/preschool classrooms for children aged 3–5 and 4–5, and compares Türkiye to other participating countries and subnational entities. The excerpt provides multiple percentage-based benchmarks (e.g., family engagement, staff qualifications, stress and satisfaction, professional development needs, and leadership practices) but does not describe any student-level predictive modeling, plausible values, or ML evaluation. Consequently, the findings should be interpreted as descriptive system and workforce indicators, with the main limitation being that the note does not document missing-data handling or uncertainty estimation details in the provided text.
